newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon to pay U.S, Dutch dividends together.
newsitem.headline: Aegon to pay U.S, Dutch dividends together.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Wednesday it would pay out its 1996 final dividend in dollars to holders of New York shares on May 30, the same time as its guilder dividend will be made payable.
It said dividends in dollars and guilders would henceforth be payable on the same date.

"To establish the dollar equivalent of the final cash dividend in Dutch guilders, Aegon will use the currency exchange rate on the first business day in Amsterdam after the company's shareholders approved the proposed dividend at Aegon's Annual General Meeting," the insurer said in a statement.
This year Aegon's AGM will be held on May 15.

The dollar equivalent of the interim cash dividend will be determined on the basis of the currency exchange rate on the first business day in Amsterdam after the pay-out proposal is approved by Aegon's supervisory board.
This year the supervisory board meeting is scheduled for August 22, with interim dividend conversion on August 23. The 1997 interim dividend will subsequently be made payable on September 18.
Aegon said in March it would pay a full-year dividend of 2.79 guilders over 1996.
